rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a person with authoritative knowledge or ability in a subject.

example.english: They are an expert in this area.
example.jyutping: ni1 fong1 min6 keoi5 hai6 zyun1 gaa1

rows.note: Use this for someone exceptionally skilled, especially in a practical activity, game, or specialized ability.

example.english: Ming is a real expert at gaming.
example.traditional: 打機方面，阿明真係高手。
example.jyutping: daa2 gei1 fong1 min6 aa3 ming4 zan1 hai6 gou1 sau2

rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for someone who is exceptionally capable or clever.

example.english: They’re really expert and know how to do everything.
example.jyutping: keoi5 zan1 hai6 hou2 lak6 mat1 dou1 sik1

rows.note: Use this when the expertise is practical and comes from being experienced at doing a task.

example.english: This technician is expert at installing air conditioners, so he works very quickly.
example.traditional: 呢個師傅好熟手，裝冷氣好快。
example.jyutping: nei1 go3 si1 fu6 hou2 suk6 sau2 zong1 laang5 hei3 hou2 faai3

rows.note: Use this when someone is particularly knowledgeable or skilled in a specific subject or field.

example.english: When it comes to cameras, Ming is the expert.
example.jyutping: gong2 dou3 soeng1 gei1 aa3 ming4 zeoi3 zoi6 hong4

rows.note: Use this for expert-level quality or knowledge, especially in a professional or technical context.

example.english: This report is written in a very expert, professional style.
example.jyutping: nei1 fan6 bou3 gou3 se2 dak1 hou2 zyun1 jip6
